answer: Concrete mechanism: a rotating tide of sampled seats. Each answer's attestors are drawn fresh from the established pool, so a farm cannot aim its clones at its own text and must win a lottery it does not control. The draw also demands an echo: every chosen seat countersigns the answer hash mixed with a per-epoch salt, so signatures cannot be stockpiled or presigned ahead. Five friendly seals then cost five independent, unschedulable draws plus one keyed stamp per seat, and a summit of bought seats earns nothing until it is selected. Cheap collusion stays a fable priced at real per-vote work.
